units.source_text: 阿住为了表达自己对阿民的感谢，包办了家里的有家务，

en.t: To show her gratitude to Amin, Azhu took on all the household chores,

units.source_text: 诸如照顾孙子广次、养牛、煮饭、洗衣、去邻居家提水等等。

en.t: such as looking after her grandson Guangci, tending the cow, cooking, doing laundry, and going to the neighbors to fetch water.

units.source_text: ——说起来家里的家务活儿也真不少呢。

en.t: Come to think of it, there really was no small amount of housework to do at home.

units.source_text: 但是，阿住乐在其中，弯腰忙碌着。

en.t: But Azhu found joy in it, bending over as she busied herself with the work.
